purpose: Block trusted QuestionGroup confirm unless the database contains the exact reviewed Grade 12 curriculum candidate, including graph relations and mappings, and the candidate was activated through CurriculumImportService.
activation_requirements: DB Curriculum/CurriculumVersion/Subject identity matches the canonical dataset and canonical stable-ID rules.
All candidate Chapters, Topics, ProblemTypes, Concepts, LearningOutcomes exist with exact reviewed fields.
All candidate ConceptRelations exist with exact source/target/relation_type and no missing candidate edge.
All candidate ProblemTypeConcept links exist with exact weight/is_primary and no missing candidate link.
All candidate ProblemTypeLearningOutcome links exist with exact weight and no missing candidate link.
The candidate-scoped DB graph fingerprint exactly equals the deterministic candidate fingerprint.
CurriculumImportHistory contains dataset_code MATH_G12_GDPT2018_CORE, dataset_version 1.2.0, and the exact canonical import content_hash expected for this candidate.
The history curriculum_version_id equals the active GDPT2018_2018 CurriculumVersion used by Subject MATH_G12.
non_goals: Do not approve Question or QuestionGroup rows.
Do not make learning/recommendation group-aware yet.
